summary: Issue #405 owner decision is fully implemented per the saved plan, and the previously-missing AWF validation evidence is now present. src/awf/node/auth_mounts_claude.py adds the _CLAUDE_AUTH_OVERLAY_UNPINNED_UPPER_DISCARDED_REBUILT reason-code constant (with explanatory comment), the _pin_matches_signature helper (incl. the OSError->False branch), and the four-conjunct discard guard inside the base-is-None block (upper.exists + _overlay_upper_has_data + not _pin_matches_signature + not is_mounted) that emits a loud warning log carrying the reason_code and rmtree's upper/work, then falls through to the unchanged post-mount _record_overlay_base_pin (no durable pre-mount pin, point 5 preserved; keep-when-verified preserved, point 2). auth_mounts.py re-exports the constant on the stable surface. Tests match the plan exactly: A (test_overlay_reboot_without_pin_rebuilds_and_repins) and B (test_prepin_upper_mount_failure_does_not_pin_guessed_base) re-encoded to assert discard+rebuild + loud reason code with documented WHY; new C (test_unpinned_upper_after_host_change_discarded_and_rebuilt, point 6) and D (test_pinned_upper_with_unmatchable_signature_discarded, point 1b + mismatch branch). validation.md records the focused AWF run: pytest 166 passed, ruff check clean, ruff format clean, mypy clean, and targeted coverage confirming _pin_matches_signature and the discard/loud-log lines are covered (not in the missing list). No generated reason-catalog change is required (node-level structured-log reason codes are not in REASON_CATALOG.md, consistent with all sibling _CLAUDE_AUTH_OVERLAY_* codes).
